# Minimalist Toolkit

Minimalist Toolkit is a web workspace that combines focused productivity tools under one account: Snippet Manager, PromptCraft, and AI Chat (with image generation).

## Public pages
- / : Product overview, workflow showcase, use cases, security and FAQ
- /login : Sign in with email/password or Google
- /signup : Create an account
- /forgot-password : Request a password reset email
- /update-password : Set a new password after opening a reset link
- /auth/callback : OAuth and email confirmation exchange

## Workspace tools (after sign-in)
- /app/dashboard : Workspace overview and analytics
- /app/snippets : Save, search, and organize reusable code
- /app/categories : Browse snippet categories and their distribution
- /app/promptcraft : Draft and improve prompts for a specific model
- /app/chat : AI chat and image generation (Mockify) in one workspace
- /app/mockify : Redirects to /app/chat image tab
- /app/profile : Account overview and library stats
- /app/settings : Account, appearance, privacy and tool preferences

## Notes
- Snippet Manager is deterministic and works without an AI key.
- PromptCraft and AI Chat need GROQ_API_KEY. Image generation uses Pollinations via a server proxy.
- Chat conversation history is stored in the browser. Snippets, PromptCraft history, and Mockify metadata sync to Supabase with owner-only RLS.
- User workspace data is private to the signed-in account.

Made by Tanveer: https://muhammadtanveerabbas.vercel.app
